statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-18140 (GHSA-8ffr-xgwf-xj56) is uncontrolled recursion in aws-smithy-json's unknown-key skip path, fixed in aws-smithy-json 0.62.7; the advisory describes a remote denial of service against smithy-rs generated servers. Milvus 3.0 includes aws-smithy-json 0.61.9 through aws-config and the AWS SSO, SSO OIDC and STS clients in the milvus-storage bridge, which use it to parse credential responses from AWS endpoints. Those client releases accept only the 0.61 line, and moving them is an AWS SDK upgrade across the bridge that remains under evaluation. See https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-8ffr-xgwf-xj56
